bio.text: Valerie Foushee represents North Carolina's 4th Congressional District; she won the seat in 2022 and is the first African American and first woman to represent it.
She grew up in Chapel Hill, served on the Chapel Hill-Carrboro school board from 1997 to 2004, and was elected to the Orange County Board of Commissioners in 2004.
She worked for the Chapel Hill Police Department for 21 years, retiring in 2008, and graduated from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill that year.
She was elected to the North Carolina General Assembly in 2012, serving as a state representative and then state senator.
